== English errata comparison sources ==
The November 1998 Glossary gives the complete Decipher replacement. The foil and the existing full and slip images match it. The December 2021 announcement and later Appendix A add the parenthetical. The PC state has no matched card image or verified separate GEMP ID.

* Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=111|Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, PDF page 111.
* Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=29|Decipher Errata]], official text as of June 2017, PDF page 29.
* [[:File:CC-L-redemption.gif|Decipher replacement in the historical full image]].
* Gergall, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1362321#p1362321 Current Rulings and Errata], Players Committee, 7 December 2021.
* Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2022/SWCCG_2022_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=121 Advanced Rulebook v3.28], Appendix A, PDF page 121.
* Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=126|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 126.
